```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

rt_data <- read.csv("summary_SRTT_master_data.csv") %>%
  mutate(SubjectID = factor(SubjectID),
         Group = factor(Group),
         Block = factor(as.integer(Block)))

# ============================================================
# Subject counts per Group x Task
# ============================================================

rt_data %>%
  distinct(SubjectID, Group, Task) %>%
  count(Group, Task)

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. MEAN RT -- ACQUISITION
# ============================================================

rt_acq <- rt_data %>% filter(Task == "Acquisition")

rt_acq_mod <- lmer(Mean.RT. ~ Group * Block + (1|SubjectID), data = rt_acq)
anova(rt_acq_mod)

# Compute Group comparisons at every block, then filter to the ones of interest
rt_acq_emm <- emmeans(rt_acq_mod, ~ Group | Block)
rt_acq_ph <- pairs(rt_acq_emm) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(Block %in% c("2", "8", "13", "14")) %>%
  mutate(p.adj.bonf = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"))
rt_acq_ph

rt_acq_es <- eff_size(rt_acq_emm, sigma = sigma(rt_acq_mod), edf = df.residual(rt_acq_mod)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(Block %in% c("2", "8", "13", "14"))
rt_acq_es


# ============================================================
# 2. MEAN RT -- RETENTION
# ============================================================

rt_ret <- rt_data %>% filter(Task == "Retention")

rt_ret_mod <- lmer(Mean.RT. ~ Group * Block + (1|SubjectID), data = rt_ret)
anova(rt_ret_mod)

rt_ret_emm <- emmeans(rt_ret_mod, ~ Group | Block)
rt_ret_ph <- pairs(rt_ret_emm) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(Block %in% c("1", "2")) %>%
  mutate(p.adj.bonf = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"))
rt_ret_ph

rt_ret_es <- eff_size(rt_ret_emm, sigma = sigma(rt_ret_mod), edf = df.residual(rt_ret_mod)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(Block %in% c("1", "2"))
rt_ret_es
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 6. BETWEEN-GROUP COMPARISONS
# ============================================================

# Pooled-SD Cohen's d for two independent samples (Sequence - Random)
cohen_d <- function(x, y) {
  nx <- length(x); ny <- length(y)
  s_pooled <- sqrt(((nx - 1) * var(x) + (ny - 1) * var(y)) / (nx + ny - 2))
  (mean(x) - mean(y)) / s_pooled
}

# Compare one metric between groups, separately for each Task
group_compare <- function(df, value) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Task) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      seq_vals <- .x[[value]][.x$Group == "Sequence"]
      ran_vals <- .x[[value]][.x$Group == "Random"]
      tt <- t.test(seq_vals, ran_vals)
      tibble(
        n_seq    = length(seq_vals),
        n_ran    = length(ran_vals),
        mean_seq = mean(seq_vals),
        mean_ran = mean(ran_vals),
        t        = unname(tt$statistic),
        df       = unname(tt$parameter),
        p.value  = tt$p.value,
        cohen_d  = cohen_d(seq_vals, ran_vals)
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# ---- Skill (mean RT-based) ----
skill_data <- read.csv("SRTT_skill_metric_all.csv")
group_compare(skill_data, "skill")

speed_data_means <- read.csv("SRTT_skill_speed_metric_all.csv")
group_compare(speed_data_means, "skill_speed")


summed_gains <- read.csv("SRTT_seq2seq_summed_gains_all.csv")

group_compare(summed_gains, "summed_micro_online")

group_compare(summed_gains, "summed_micro_offline")

group_compare(summed_gains, "summed_total_speed")
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7. RELATIONSHIPS: skill vs cumulative micro gains
# ============================================================

corr_data <- read.csv("SRTT_acquisition_gain_skill_correlations.csv") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group))


# Correlate columns x and y within each Group
group_corr <- function(df, x, y) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      ct <- cor.test(.x[[x]], .x[[y]])
      tibble(
        n       = nrow(.x),
        r       = unname(ct$estimate),
        t       = unname(ct$statistic),
        df      = unname(ct$parameter),
        p.value = ct$p.value
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Fig 3A: Acquisition skill vs cumulative micro-online gains
group_corr(corr_data, "skill_acquisition", "summed_micro_online_acquisition")

# Fig 3B: Acquisition skill vs cumulative micro-offline gains
group_corr(corr_data, "skill_acquisition", "summed_micro_offline_acquisition")

# Fig 3C: Retention skill vs cumulative micro-online gains
group_corr(corr_data, "skill_retention", "summed_micro_online_acquisition")

# Fig 3D: Retention skill vs cumulative micro-offline gains
group_corr(corr_data, "skill_retention", "summed_micro_offline_acquisition")

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 8. IMPLICIT SEQUENCE KNOWLEDGE -- PDP (inclusion / exclusion scores)
#    group 1 = Sequence, group 2 = No-sequence.
# ============================================================


std.error <- function(x, na.rm = TRUE) {
  if (na.rm) x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
}

pdp <- read.csv("SRTT_PDP.csv")

pdp_learn   <- subset(pdp, group == 1)   # Sequence group
pdp_nolearn <- subset(pdp, group == 2)   # No-Sequence group

# ---- Sequence group ----
mean(pdp_learn$inclusion, na.rm = TRUE)
std.error(pdp_learn$inclusion, na.rm = TRUE)
t.test(pdp_learn$inclusion, mu = 4)


mean(pdp_learn$exclusion, na.rm = TRUE)
std.error(pdp_learn$exclusion, na.rm = TRUE)
t.test(pdp_learn$exclusion, mu = 8, na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- No-Sequence group ----
mean(pdp_nolearn$inclusion, na.rm = TRUE)
std.error(pdp_nolearn$inclusion, na.rm = TRUE)
t.test(pdp_nolearn$inclusion, mu = 4)

mean(pdp_nolearn$exclusion, na.rm = TRUE)
std.error(pdp_nolearn$exclusion, na.rm = TRUE)
t.test(pdp_nolearn$exclusion, mu = 8)
```
